versions.changelog:
Huawei Cloud AgentArts OpenTelemetry ingestion skill initial release.

- Enables ingestion of OTel telemetry data (traces, metrics, logs) into the AgentArts observability platform.
- Supports both APM deliverConfig forwarding (recommended) and OTLP direct ingestion paths.
- Provides AI agent observation with gen_ai semantic conventions for LLM/AI workloads.
- Includes auto-configuration for Java, Python, Node.js, and Go applications.
- Adds ingestion diagnostics and verification features via agent-ops APIs.
- Detailed setup and configuration instructions are provided in the documentation.
